quizName: DMV Practice Test #6 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: If a motorcycle is towing a trailer, how should the following distance change?
questions.explanation: A motorcyclist towing a trailer should increase their following distance. The trailer adds weight, so the motorcycle needs more time to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Service signs are blue with white letters. They show where you can find rest areas, gas stations, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: How much stopping power does a motorcycle's front brake provide?
questions.explanation: The front brake is stronger than the rear brake. It provides about three-quarters of the motorcycle's total stopping power.

questions.question: What should you tell your passenger to do when riding?

options.text: Get on the motorcycle before you
Sit as far back as possible
Hold firmly onto your waist, hips, or belt

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold firmly onto your waist, hips, or belt
questions.explanation: Tell your passenger to get on after you start the engine. They should sit as far forward as comfortable and hold firmly onto your waist, hips, or belt.

questions.question: How do you shift to a higher gear?

options.text: Place your foot under the shift lever and lift
Place your foot over the shift lever and push
Use your thumb to move the lever

questions.correctAnswerText: Place your foot under the shift lever and lift
questions.explanation: To shift to a higher gear, put your foot under the shift lever and lift it.

questions.question: What does the SEE strategy stand for?
questions.explanation: The Motorcycle Safety Foundation recommends the SEE strategy. SEE stands for Search, Evaluate, and Execute. This helps riders make safe decisions.

questions.question: What should motorcyclists do about the oily strip in the center of a traffic lane?

options.text: Find the lane with the least amount of oil

questions.explanation: Avoid riding on the oily strip. Since it is usually only two feet wide, you can often ride to the left or right of it and still be in the center part of the lane.

questions.question: How can you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: The only way to sober up is to give your body time to remove the alcohol. Nothing can speed this up.

questions.question: Where should inexperienced riders be placed when riding in a group?

options.text: Near the front of the group
In the back of the group

questions.correctAnswerText: Near the front of the group
questions.explanation: Less experienced riders should be near the front of the group, behind the leader. This allows experienced riders to lead the way and watch the inexperienced riders.

questions.question: When sitting on a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Use your arms to hold up your body.
Sit at an angle so your arms can support your weight.
Sit so you can use your arms to control the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sit so you can use your arms to control the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Sit so your arms can control the motorcycle. Your arms should not be used to hold up your body or support your weight.

questions.question: Most motorcycle and car accidents happen:
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle and car collisions happen at intersections. The main cause is when car drivers fail to give the right-of-way to motorcyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of vehicles moving slower than 25 mph. These include construction equipment, farm machinery, and horse-drawn vehicles.

questions.question: To get the most protection from your helmet, make sure it:
questions.explanation: Your helmet gives the best protection when it meets DOT and state standards, fits snugly all the way around, and has no damage.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that lets you turn in the direction you want to go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must stop completely, check for other traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: When riding in a group, mirrors:

options.text: Should be checked frequently by all riders.
Should be used only by the lead rider.
Should not be checked frequently because they can be a distraction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be checked frequently by all riders.
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, check your mirrors often. This helps you watch the riders behind you and know that the group is staying together.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, your feet should be:

options.text: Pointed with your toes aiming downward.

questions.explanation: Keep your feet firmly on the footrests for balance. Do not point your toes downward, as they may get caught between the road and the footrests.

questions.question: Motorcyclists:

options.text: Must share a lane if traffic is congested.
Are entitled to use a full lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are entitled to use a full lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists have the right to use a full traffic lane. Sharing lanes is usually dangerous and not allowed.

questions.question: You should check your motorcycle's safety before:
questions.explanation: Always check your motorcycle's safety before you ride. A small problem on a motorcycle is more dangerous than a small problem on a car.

questions.question: It is illegal to operate a motorcycle with a blood alcohol content (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: In California, drivers 21 or older cannot operate a motorcycle with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Drivers under 21 cannot operate a motorcycle with any alcohol in their system (0.01 percent or higher). It may be unsafe to ride even if you are below the legal limit.

questions.question: In general, which position within a lane is the best to ride in?

options.text: There is no single best lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is no single best lane position.
questions.explanation: No single lane position is always best or always worst. A good rider changes their position based on the current conditions.

questions.question: When approaching a blind intersection, riders should:

options.text: Stop at the stop line before moving forward to improve their view of cross traffic.
Ignore the stop line and move forward to get a better look.
Stop at the stop line then proceed through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at the stop line before moving forward to improve their view of cross traffic.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection with a stop sign or stop line, stop where indicated. Then move forward slowly and stop again just before entering the cross traffic lane. Lean forward and look around buildings, parked cars, or bushes to check for traffic. Keep your front wheel out of the crossroad while looking.

questions.question: Before starting a turn, a motorcyclist should change gears to:

options.text: Prevent a change in power in the middle of the turn.
Be able to keep both hands on the handle grips during the turn.
Prevent the motorcycle from slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prevent a change in power in the middle of the turn.
questions.explanation: Change gears before you start a turn. Shifting while turning can cause a sudden power change to the rear wheel, which may cause a skid. If you must shift during a turn, do it smoothly to reduce the risk of skidding.

questions.question: A motorcyclist is usually most easily seen by other drivers when they are riding in which lane position?
questions.explanation: When traffic allows, ride in the center lane position. This places you in the driver's rearview mirror where they can see you best. Always be ready to change positions if traffic or road conditions require it.
